title: Mean of a restriction and its constant coefficient
statement: Let $J$ be a set of coordinates in the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and fix a sign assignment $z$ on the complementary coordinates. The mean of the restriction of a real-valued function $f$ to the free coordinates equals the Fourier coefficient indexed by the empty set of that restricted function; equivalently, it equals the mean of $f$ over the free coordinates with $z$ held fixed.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
A fixed sign assignment on the coordinates outside $J$
